Ɖoɖo ɖa nu tsitsi tutua gbedeasi siwo wotsɔ ɖe lalamɔ la dzi va se ɖe biabia la ƒe ɣeyiɣi. Ne ɖoɖo ɖa le dzɔdzɔm la, gbugbɔ agbagba dze le ɣeyiɣi aɖe megbe. Womate ŋu agbugbɔ gbedeasi si ɖoɖo ɖa dze egɔme xoxo la axɔ o, eye ɖoɖo ɖa si ƒe emetsonu meka ɖe edzi o la ate ŋu adzɔ ake. Vodada siwo anɔ anyi tegbee kple gbedeasi siwo va ɖo agbagbadzedze ƒe seɖoƒe la anɔ anyi na numetoto. import-board-instruction-asana: Tsɔ Asana dɔwo ƒe JSON si wotsɔ ɖe go de afisia ({ "data": [...] } tso Asana ƒe nuɖeɖego alo GET /tasks). Woƒu dɔwo ƒu ɖe akpa me (memberships); dɔ siwo wowu nu la yina Done.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Le Businessmap (si wona ŋkɔ Kanbanize tsã) me la, ʋu Advanced Search, tia Configure results be nàtia ƒlowo, xɔ Excel faɛl la, emegbe tia .xlsx faɛl ma. Woxlẽa ƒlowo le woƒe Eŋlisigbe ŋkɔwo nu (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ne wò akɔnta zãa gbe bubu la, trɔ tanya ƒe fli la ƒe ŋkɔwo wòazu Eŋlisigbe gbã. Column zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye Lane zua tsiƒuƒuwo; tɔwo, tags, ama, ŋkekewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo kple dzitsotso ƒe kadodowo léa woƒe teƒewo ɖe asi, eye Priority, Size, Type kple ƒlo bubuwo zua agble tɔxɛwo.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Le ClickUp me la, ɖe dɔwo abe CSV ene (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, alo List alo Table nukpɔkpɔ ƒe ɖeɖe kple ƒlowo katã), emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo, ClickUp xexlẽdzesiwo zua tsiƒuƒuwo, eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo kple woƒe dɔviwo, dɔwɔlawo, tags, ŋkekewo, nu vevitɔ kple ɣeyiɣi.
import-board-instruction-csv: Tsɔ nusiwo woma kple koma (CSV)/ nusiwo woma kple tab (TSV) de afisia.
import-board-instruction-deck: Tsɔ NextCloud Deck kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe JSON de afisia (kpekpeɖeŋu si me "stacks" le, stack ɖesiaɖe kɔa eƒe "cards"). Stacks atrɔ̃ azu xexlẽdzesiwo eye cards atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo.
import-board-instruction-excel: Tia WeKan-nɔnɔme ƒe .xlsx kplɔ̃gbalẽ (agble ɖeka siwo le Excel ƒe nuɖeɖego me: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Fli gbãtɔ nye tameŋɔŋlɔ.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ʋu .boardarchive ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe eye nàte kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe board.jsonl ɖe afisia, kple eƒe tɔtrɔ ƒe fli alo emanɔmee. Nɔnɔme si ƒoa nuwo nu ƒu ɖe ƒuƒoƒowo me le kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nukpɔkpɔ me trɔna dzua xexlẽdzesiwo, tiatia ƒe nɔnɔme bubuwo trɔna dzua dzesiwo, nuŋɔŋlɔ kple dzesidede ƒe aɖaka ƒe akpa siwo le eme trɔna dzua numeɖeɖe kple dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi, eye woléa nuŋɔŋlɔwo ɖe asi. Wometsɔa nɔnɔmetatawo kple kpeɖeŋu-agbalẽwo va eme o.
import-board-instruction-issues: Tsɔ __sourceName__ ƒe kuxiwo ƒe JSON fli de afisia (__endpoint__). Kuxiwo atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo si woƒu ƒu ɖe Open / Closed xexlẽdzesiwo me.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Tsɔ Kanboard ƒe JSON si wotsɔ ɖe go la de afisia: nu si me "columns" le (alo dɔ siwo kɔ column_name) kple "tasks" ƒe fli (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns atrɔ̃ azu xexlẽdzesiwo eye tasks atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Le Kanri me la, ʋu Import & Export eye nàtia Export individual board (alo Export all data), emegbe tsɔ .json faɛl la de eme. Ƒlowo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye kaɖiwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe numeɖeɖe, ŋkeke mamlɛ, tags kple amawo; kaɖi ƒe dɔwo zua ŋkuɖodzinudzesi. Le nyatakakawo katã ƒe ɖeɖe me la, wotsɔa kpekpeɖeŋu gbãtɔ vaa eme.
import-board-instruction-leo: Kle Leo ƒe ɖoɖo (faɛl .leo) ɖe afisia. Akpa siwo le ɣome si kɔ wu la zu xexlẽdzesiwo, akpa siwo le wo te tẽ la zu agbalẽviwo, eye akpa la ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ zu agbalẽvi la ƒe numeɖeɖe. Akpa siwo le ɣome siwo le eme goglo wu la zu dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesiwo. Wotsɔa akpa siwo wode dzesi la va eme abe nu siwo wu enu ene.
import-board-instruction-linear: Le Linear me la, ɖe nyawo abe CSV ene (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, alo nukpɔkpɔ aɖe ƒe ɖeɖe), emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo, ƒuƒoƒowo zua tsiƒuƒuwo, eye nyawo zua kaɖiwo kple woƒe dɔwɔla, dzesiwo, ŋkekewo, nya dzitsotso, nu vevitɔ, akɔntabubu, dɔ kple ɣeyiɣi ƒe trɔtrɔ.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Tsɔ markdown dɔwɔwɔ ƒe xexlẽme pepa ɖo (mɔ si markdown-kanban dɔwɔnu siwo abe Obsidian Kanban ene zãna): "## List ƒe ŋkɔ" tanya siwo, kple nu siwo nye "- [ ]"/"- [x]" le woƒe te. Tanya siwo trɔna zua lisiwo eye nu siwo trɔna zua kaatawo; bullet list tsɔtsɔ si mele checkbox aɖeke ŋu o hã ge ɖe eme, abe kaata ʋuʋu ene.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Le MeisterTask me la, zi dɔ la ƒe ŋkɔ dzi, tia Export project eye nàɖe CSV la, emegbe tsɔe de eme. Akpawo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo, ŋkeke mamlɛ, dɔwɔla kple tags; dɔ siwo wowu nu la léa woƒe nuwuwuŋkeke ɖe asi. CSV si woŋlɔ na MeisterTask ŋutɔ ƒe nuxɔxɔ hã wɔa dɔ.
import-board-instruction-monday: Le monday.com me la, ʋu kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nuɖoɖowo, tia More actions kple Export board to Excel (kple updates kple subitems ne èdi), emegbe tia .xlsx faɛl ma. Status ƒlo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye ƒuƒoƒowo zua tsiƒuƒuwo; amewo, ŋkekewo, ɣeyiɣi ƒe mɔ kple tags léa woƒe teƒewo ɖe asi, ƒlo bubuwo zua agble tɔxɛwo eye updates zua nyaŋuɖoɖowo.
import-board-instruction-notion: Le Notion me la, ʋu nyatakakadzraɖoƒe la abe axa blibo ene, tia ••• kple Export, tia Markdown & CSV, eye nàtia .zip faɛl si wòxɔ, alo nyatakakadzraɖoƒe CSV ɖeka tso eme, alo tsɔ CSV ma de eme. Ƒlo si ŋkɔ nye Status la zua xexlẽdzesiwo (ne eya meli o la, ƒlo gbãtɔ si dze abe tiatia ene la zuna, eye nuxɔxɔ ƒe nyatakaka gblɔa esi wònye); fliwo zua kaɖiwo kple woƒe ŋkɔ, tags abe dzesiwo ene, amewo abe dzolawo ene, ŋkekewo, kple axa ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ abe numeɖeɖe ene; ƒlo bubuwo zua agble tɔxɛwo. Wometsɔa kadodowo, nɔnɔmetatawo kple nu siwo wokpe ɖe eŋu vaa eme o.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Le Nullboard me la, ʋu kpekpeɖeŋu la, tia Export this board... le nuɖoɖowo me, ʋu .nbx faɛl la le nuŋlɔdɔwɔnu me eye nàtsɔ eme nuwo de eme. Xexlẽdzesiwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye nuŋlɔɖiwo zua kaɖiwo: nuŋlɔɖi ƒe fli gbãtɔ nye kaɖi ƒe ŋkɔ eye esusɔea nye eƒe numeɖeɖe. Nuŋlɔɖi si womeɖo ɖoɖo na o la xɔa dzesi raw. Faɛl si me kpekpeɖeŋu geɖe le la tsɔa eƒe kpekpeɖeŋu gbãtɔ vaa eme.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Le Obsidian me la, ʋu Kanban kpekpeɖeŋu la ƒe faɛl abe Markdown ene (alo ʋu .md faɛl la le nuŋlɔdɔwɔnu me), emegbe tsɔ ewo katã de eme. Mɔwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo kple woƒe kaɖiwo ƒe seɖoƒe, kaɖiwo léa woƒe tags, ŋkekewo, nu vevitɔ, agblewo kple ŋkuɖodzinudzesi ɖe asi, eye Archive zua kaɖi siwo le nudzraɖoƒe.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Tsɔ OpenProject ƒe dɔ-kpekpewo ƒe JSON de afisia (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Nɔnɔmewo atrɔ̃ azu xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔ-kpekpewo atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo.
import-board-instruction-opml: Tsɔ OPML ƒe ɖoɖo de eme, abe ale si Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq kple ɖoɖowɔdɔwɔnu bubuwo ɖenɛ ene. Nu siwo le tame zua xexlẽdzesiwo, woƒe viwo zua kaɖiwo kple nuŋlɔɖi abe numeɖeɖe ene, eye nu siwo le te wu zua ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo. Nu siwo wowu nu la vaa eme abe nu siwo wowu ene.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Tsɔ Org mode faɛl de eme, abe ale si Emacs, Orgzly alo Beorg ŋlɔnɛ ene. Tanya siwo le tame zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye tanya siwo le ɖoƒe evelia zua kaɖiwo. Wodzraa TODO kple DONE, nu vevitɔwo, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE kple CLOSED ɖo, eye dzesideɖefewo kple tanya siwo le te wu zua ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Le Pivotal Tracker me la, ʋu dɔ la ƒe MORE axa eye nàtia Export CSV (alo tia ŋutinyawo eye nàtia Bulk Actions, CSV), emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Ŋutinya ƒe nɔnɔme ɖesiaɖe zua xexlẽdzesi eye ŋutinyawo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe ƒomevi kple dzesiwo, tɔwo, biala, ŋkekewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo, dɔwo kple mɔxenuwo; Estimate zua Story points eye trɔtrɔwo zua sprints.
import-board-instruction-plane: Le Plane me la, ʋu Workspace Settings, tia Exports, ɖe dɔwo abe JSON, CSV alo Excel ene eye nàxɔ .zip faɛl la, emegbe tia faɛl ma, alo faɛl ɖeka si le eme, alo tsɔ JSON alo CSV la de eme. Nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo, dɔwo zua tsiƒuƒuwo, eye nyawo zua kaɖiwo kple woƒe dzesidenu, dzitsotso, dɔwɔlawo, dzesiwo, ŋkekewo, kadodowo kple nyaŋuɖoɖowo; priority, estimate, cycle kple module zua agble tɔxɛwo. Numeɖeɖe alo nu siwo wokpe ɖe eŋu aɖeke mele Plane ƒe ɖeɖe me o, eyata wometsɔa wo vaa eme o.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: Le Quire me la, ʋu dɔ la ƒe nuɖoɖowo eye nàtia Export CSV, emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe dɔviwo abe kaɖiviwo ene, dɔwɔlawo, tags abe dzesiwo ene, gɔmedzedze, mamlɛ kple nuwuwu ŋkekewo, numeɖeɖe kple nu vevitɔ abe agble tɔxɛ ene. Nyaŋuɖoɖowo kple nu siwo wokpe ɖe eŋu mele Quire ƒe CSV me o.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Le Redmine me la, ʋu dɔ la ƒe Issues, tia Also available in: CSV le xexlẽdzesi la ƒe te, tia ƒlowo (All columns, kple Description) eye nàɖee, emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Redmine naa ŋkɔ ƒlowo le wò gbe me, eyata ɖo wò gbe be wòanye Eŋlisigbe le My account me hafi nàɖee.
